C1104.title: Five Men Sentenced for Using AI Face-Swapping to Tamper with System Data for Profit
keywords: illegally obtaining computer information system data
C1104.summary: In July 2024, China News Service published a report titled Five Men Sentenced for Using AI Face-Swapping to Tamper with System Data for Profit. The report concerns a criminal case involving AI face-swapping to bypass platform authentication, tamper with system data, and profit from the activity, making it a factual case for biometric forgery and facial-recognition bypass risks; defendant details, amounts, and sentences should be checked against the original article text.
